text: I'd like you to make a testimonial-style ad for FitTrack, with someone talking directly to the camera. I’m hoping it feels approachable because fitness planning can seem a little intimidating to me. It should be 8 seconds long and vertical, and the presenter should be a fictional woman in her 30s filming herself at home. Have her say, “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Keep it friendly and casual, with matching captions, and use a made-up presenter rather than a real customer.
